pages.text: Press $(bold)J$() for the claim manager (FTB Chunks). Left-click a chunk to claim it for your team, right-click to unclaim. Claimed land cannot be broken, opened or blown up by anyone outside your team or its allies.$(br2)The capital is claimed by the server. Claim your own place as soon as you have one worth keeping.

$(bold)Teams:$() you are your own team until you make a party. $(bold)/ftbteams party create$() then $(bold)/ftbteams party invite <name>$() shares claims and chests. Allies see and can use your things; they can also be set to only see.$(br2)Up to 200 chunks per team. Nobody needs that many; if you do, you have built a city.

$(bold)Force-loading$() (shift-click a claimed chunk) keeps it running while you are away, as long as someone on your team is online: crops grow, machines turn. $(bold)Four chunks per team$(), hard cap; while you are all offline, a Steward keeps land running for a fee. Enough for one farm or one Create line; not enough for a factory, on purpose.$(br2)The server has one game thread. What you keep loaded, everybody pays for.
